Description: Edmund Galley and Martha Galley talk in the room. Edmund confides his relationship troubles with Victoria Maseko and seeks help. Martha says she is busy with other matters. Tension rises. After thunder, Edmund is confused and leaves.
Location: Master bedroom（Master bedroom）
Key Information:
  - No. 6 Edmund Galley enters the room and tries to talk with Martha Galley.
  - Edmund says he proposed to Victoria Maseko and was rejected; he is depressed.
  - Martha says she is busy dealing with other matters and cannot help Edmund with his feelings.
  - Martha criticizes Edmund for not being independent; she says she is overwhelmed too and can’t bear more burdens.
  - Martha says: ‘Yesterday, after we found that female corpse, you came to me first,’ highlighting Edmund’s reaction to the body.
  - Thunder sounds, marking someone’s death. Edmund becomes more confused and ultimately decides to leave.
  - Edmund apologizes and leaves; Martha continues focusing on her own tasks.
Characters:
  [Edmund Galley（Edmund Galley）] Person No. 6, Martha Galley’s son, heartbroken and seeking his mother’s help.
    · Talks about Victoria rejecting his proposal and says he lost the most important person.
    · Asks Martha for help and feels disappointed when she refuses.
    · After thunder, grows more confused and leaves.
    · Martha’s remark about the corpse shows how strongly it affected him.
  [Martha Galley（Martha Galley）] Person No. 5, Edmund’s mother, busy dealing with other matters.
    · Talks with Edmund but says she cannot help him.
    · Criticizes Edmund’s lack of independence and says she is overwhelmed.
    · Apologizes before he leaves and keeps working.
    · Mentions Edmund came to her first after discovering the female corpse.
